correctness.rationale: Proof independently establishes squarefreeness, genus, q²-Frobenius antisymmetry, nonsquare obstruction in F_(q⁴), exact N4=N2, and applies the published universal upper bound. Complete C++ enumeration traverses all 3^9 and 3^10 monic forms, tests gcd(f,f'), evaluates F9/F81 exactly, obtains 13,122 and 39,366 smooth forms and exactly one B4-zero polynomial. Quadratic twists have identical N2,N4 and are isomorphic by x->-x for the survivor. Standalone independent Python witness check passes. Finite classification is limited to F3 and the hyperelliptic locus; it is not misrepresented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The classification completely solves the natural closed-point obstruction B4=0 within the entire genus-four hyperelliptic locus over F3: 52,488 smooth normalized monic presentations are exhausted, and quadratic twists collapse to exactly one ground-field isomorphism class. Its witness makes the general rho bound sharp for an infinite geometrically natural genus sequence, including the first untreated genus-four case rho(3,4)=5. The uniqueness and infinite sharpness go beyond restating the general upper bound; explicit exact finite arithmetic makes the result reusable. Nonhyperelliptic genus-four uniqueness is not claimed.
